LEGAL

Privacy Policy

Last updated: June 30, 2026

[BRAND_TBD], a division of FoodScience Corporation™ values our private label partners and their privacy. All personal and business information you provide is used to evaluate your inquiry, deliver private label services, and maintain the working relationship between your business and ours. We do not give, sell, rent, or loan any personally identifiable information to any third party, unless we are legally required to do so or you authorize us to do so.

WHAT WE COLLECT

Information Collection and Use.

Our website includes forms and contact options that ask you to provide business contact information: your name, business name, email address, phone number, and details about the supplement products and volumes you are interested in. We use this information to follow up on your inquiry, schedule consultations, send pricing information, and provide the educational resources you have requested.

We also collect standard web analytics information automatically when you visit the site: pages viewed, time on site, referring source, browser type, and approximate geographic location. We use this information to improve the site, understand what content is most useful to our audience, and identify technical issues.

You can opt out of marketing communications at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in any email we send, or by contacting us directly.

SECURITY

How We Protect Your Information.

This website takes every precaution to protect the information you submit. Sensitive information submitted through our forms is protected with encryption in transit and at rest. Access to your information is limited to [BRAND_TBD] team members who need it to provide private label services to you.

When you submit business inquiries through our forms, that information is transmitted securely and stored in our customer relationship management system. We follow industry-standard practices for data security and review our practices regularly.

If you have any questions about how your information is collected, used, stored, or protected, please email us at info@[BRAND_TBD].com or use the contact form on our Contact page.

THIRD-PARTY SERVICES

Service Providers We Use.

We use a small number of third-party service providers to operate this website and our private label program. These include website hosting, customer relationship management, email delivery, analytics, and advertising platforms. Each provider has access only to the information they need to perform their function and is bound by confidentiality obligations.

We do not sell information about you to advertising platforms or data brokers.

YOUR RIGHTS

Your Rights and Choices.

You can request access to the personal information we hold about you, correction of inaccurate information, or deletion of your information from our systems at any time. Send requests to info@[BRAND_TBD].com and we will respond within 30 days.

You can opt out of marketing emails by clicking unsubscribe in any email. Note that even if you opt out of marketing, we may still send you transactional emails related to an active private label engagement.

CONTACT

Privacy Questions.

Questions about this privacy policy or about how we handle your information can be sent to info@[BRAND_TBD].com or mailed to [BRAND_TBD], a division of FoodScience Corporation™, 929 Harvest Lane, Williston, VT 05495.
